## Food and Beverages (FnB)

"Food and Beverages" is an entity dedicated to tracking locations where one can eat or drink.

## Fields

1. Type
   fnb
2. Image 
   Image of the FnB   
3. Country
   The country the location is in
4. City
   Reference to the City this place is in, if it's inside a tracked City -- falls back to just Country when it isn't
5. Geo Location (text input)
   Copy the geolocation from the map view and past it here
6. FnB Type (select single value from list)
    - Bar
    - Cafe
    - Fast Food
    - Pub
    - Restaurant
7. Visited (true/false)
   Marks a location as visited
8. Last Visit (select date value from date picker)
9. Rating (1-5)
10. Tags
    - Travel/Location
    - Food
